video_title: Stephen A Smith be like it be your OWN teammates in the NBA that be getting them 👀

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on players holding teammates accountable for soft play
quotes.quote: Here's the thing that so many cats have missed throughout the years. Let's say, for example, I soft-soaked some sh*t and I could have came harder, but I didn't. Do you know who would come up to me and get on me about it? The other players! 'Yeah, your ass was a little bit soft today. You could have went harder.' And I'm like, 'Really, that's what we doing?' 'You would have did it to me!' True. Okay. No problem.
